clips.title: The story
paras: Covert Ops - Beta is an Alliance mission organized by the gnome engineer Gaxim Rustfizzle in the Stonetalon Mountains. Building upon previous sabotage against the encroaching Venture Company, this operation sends an agent deep into Windshear Mine to trigger explosive diversions and extract vital operational letters. The retrieved intelligence serves both gnome curiosity and the territorial defense of the regional night elf Sentinels.

Following initial strikes against the Venture Company's clear-cutting operations across Windshear Crag, Gaxim Rustfizzle devises a follow-up operation aimed directly at their logistical heart. Plan Beta follows the same fundamental logic as its predecessor: creating an explosive, chaotic diversion to scatter the goblin operators and mercenaries while an operative slips through the confusion to search the mines for written correspondence.

Windshear Mine sits at the far eastern reaches of the crag, serving as the company's regional subterranean base. Digging through rock and harvesting timber, the goblins maintain strict ledgers and communications detailing their supply lines and executive directives. By sneaking inside, setting Gaxim's specialized explosive packs, and seizing the Venture Co. Letters, operatives dismantle the company's security while uncovering their wider ambitions in Kalimdor.

While Gaxim approaches the mission with typical gnomish delight for pyrotechnics and clever gadgetry, the mission has serious strategic implications for the night elves. The Sentinels in Stonetalon, led by commanders like Kaela Shadowspear, are hard-pressed battling both the Horde and ruthless industrial exploiters. The intelligence recovered from the mine directly assists the Sentinels in predicting and thwarting the defilement of their sacred woodlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Plan Beta's just like Plan Alpha, friend.
We cause a distraction and then steal their precious letters.
The key is to get their letters... Remember that.
The pages I gave you already will tell you where to plant the explosives. Just get back here alive and with those letters....

clips.title: Completion
paras: Incredible, friend! Kaela and the Sentinels will be so happy. With your skill and my creations, we're unstoppable.
